title: 機械学習
subtitle: Machine Learning
keywords: Artificial intelligence 2.Machine learning 3.Regression and Classification 4.Neural Network 5.Dicision treee
educationalGoal: One of the central themes of artificial intelligence is machine learning. Machine learning is a technology that learns patterns and rules from large amounts of data and makes predictions based on them, serving as a foundation for the practical implementation of AI. This course aims to teach the fundamental theories and practical skills of machine learning. Students will learn basic algorithms and methods for building models while implementing them using libraries such as Python and Scikit-learn.
advice: The course will progress through a combination of lectures (including Q&A), exercises, quizzes, and report assignments as appropriate. The central topics covered in this course are as follows: 1. Regression and classification 2. Neural networks 3. Decision trees The course will follow the syllabus; however, adjustments may be made depending on the level of understanding. Preparation is essential, and students are expected to thoroughly review the material after each class and complete the report assignments to solidify their knowledge and apply it effectively.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of calculus, linear algebra, and the ability to program in Python are assumed as prerequisites.

activityGoals.body: Explain the fundamental concepts and methods of regression models.
Explain the fundamental concepts and methods of neural networks.
Explain the fundamental concepts and methods of decision trees.
Implement basic machine learning algorithms using the Python programming language.
